note: top navigation bar, logo, search box, and user links -- operator's own interface
left navigation panel -- namespace tabs and associated pages, operator's fixed vocabulary
right navigation panel -- view, edit, history tabs and page tools, operator's fixed vocabulary
appearance settings panel -- font size, width, theme options, operator's fixed vocabulary
footer -- site links, copyright, privacy policy, and other operator-controlled footer links
page title bar chrome -- renders: language selector dropdown; the page title heading is subtracted as it echoes the user-named category
page indicators -- help link and other operator indicators
page subtitle -- operator copy such as 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'
jump to content link -- operator's own interface control
